tip.en: Small talk: ask a short question back — “And you?” keeps the conversation going.

tip.kk: Small talk: қысқа сұрақ қайтар — «And you?» әңгімені жалғастырады.

acts.title: A night in New York
text: One night in 2008, Julio Diaz was in a train station in New York. 🚉
A boy asked him for his money. Diaz gave him his wallet — and his jacket. 🧥
Then he said: “Do you want something to eat?” The boy said yes. 🍽
They went to a restaurant. They ate and talked.
At the end Diaz paid the bill and gave the boy twenty dollars. 💵

items.s: Julio Diaz was in a train station.
The boy wanted money from Diaz.
Diaz gave him only his wallet.
They went to a restaurant together.
Diaz paid the bill.
Diaz gave the boy nothing at the end.

Unit 5 · You are in a café and you want one cup of coffee.
items.why: “I’d like…” is the polite way to order.

o: Would you like to join us this evening?
Do you want join us this evening?

o: No, I wasn’t. This is my first time.
No, I weren’t. This is my first time.
No, I am not here last year.

write.q: Write your small talk with a stranger: 8 lines. Use a hello, three questions from different units, one answer about the past, and a goodbye.
write.model: Hello. Nice to meet you. I’m Aidana. Where are you from? — I’m from Astana. What do you do? — I’m a nurse. How often do you come to Almaty? — Twice a year. What’s the weather like in Astana now? — It’s snowing. Were you here last year? — No, I wasn’t. Would you like a coffee? — See you later!

speak.q: Have the whole conversation out loud: greet, ask three questions, answer one about yesterday, invite, and say goodbye.
speak.model: Good morning. I’m Aidana. Nice to meet you. Where are you from? What do you do? How often do you travel? Yesterday I was at home — it was cold and rainy. Would you like a coffee? Sounds good. See you later!
